name: Kettle 6: Send Email
description: Shopify ops (project 9): sends an email with Gmail in live mode or writes it to the Kettle Outbox table in test mode.

parameters.content:
## Kettle 6: Send Email
Every email (cart recovery, reports, alerts, support tickets) goes through here. With `mode = live` in **Kettle Settings** it sends with Gmail; in test mode it writes to the **Kettle Outbox** table instead, so nothing reaches a customer while testing.
